Broad detailChains [{id,path,steps:[{testId|role+name|selector,urlPattern,expectedText},...]} with >=2 real figure-to-detail-to-folio steps; unitChecks [{id,path,expectedSeparateLabels,forbiddenMixedLabels}]; colorChecks [{id,path,semanticLabels}]. These are assertions on real data, never mocked responses.
Targets return-debt/return-settled {path} to authentic synthetic note/roll routes. Inspector records real UI availability and preserves business block; it does not authorize refund.
safety: Compiler and --plan do not contact an app or database.
No DDL, server launch, workflow restart, DB direct writes, app edits or commits in this deliverable.
Generated adapters reuse original files read-only, parameterize historical hosts/users/IDs/dates, reject missing target IDs and guard replay.
Legacy raw child output stays under privateDir with mode 0600. Report text redacts passwords/tokens/DSNs. Screenshots are actual Playwright PNGs generated only during explicit execution.
Do not run --all blindly: plan lists coverage, not a substitute for fixture dependency and cash-session checks.
knownCoverageLimits: Historical fiscal loop was adapted rather than the old reconcile.mjs because the old script reconciles empty hardcoded periods, stops at first failure, and never proves ADMIN notification. Adapter exercises equivalent native reconciliation controls with authenticated readback and ADMIN notification.
Audit port removes historical direct PostgreSQL reads and API fixture creation; it requires explicit fixture handoff and reads back through authenticated real API.
No claim that source HEAD gates or features are released in the frozen bundle. UI/API absence is a recorded block.
Money-flow legacy substeps stop within a dependent case after a failure; the runner records subsequent cases independently.
Detailed exploratory manual button coverage and visual color meaning still require MAIN/tester review; empty contracts are BLOCKED, not coverage PASS.
